purpose: Compare plain LLM, LLM plus local code, and Causora on the same answer-free frozen controls using scorer-only expected labels and a shared strict scoring rule.

sharedControls.rule: Expected labels are scorer-only and must never be supplied in a model prompt or provider capture.

capturedResultSchema.notes: A COMPLETED capture must have every shared case exactly once, no unknown/duplicate case, a structured answer, control evidence reference, poison-pill flags, frozen input/prompt hashes, and reproducibility evidence. A failed, cancelled, or timed-out capture is evidence of that outcome, not a zero-cost success. Completion and answer correctness are scored separately.

comparisonRules: Oracle controls are pending real human-review documentation and are evaluated by evaluation/oracle/independent_oracle.py without importing the simulation engine.
Causora uses production rounding, P90, and selection helpers on the same shared controls; the historic Golden reconciliation audit is reported separately and is not a comparison score.
Missing LLM captures remain NOT_RUN_NO_PAID_AUTHORIZATION and must not be imputed or presented as a result.

Every real model capture must include the exact control-case IDs, model identifier, elapsed time, provider-reported usage/cost if available, frozen input/prompt hashes, and a redacted audit reference.
Scores include exact answer accuracy, control-evidence coverage, poison-pill recognition, and reproducibility identity.
